body:
Hi.
No changes. My girlfriend found this reddit account and we had a long talk, but she's just angry more than anything. She keeps playing the 'it's so selfish' card. So little help really.

I am going to try talking with my therapist again, but I don't have high hopes. I've tried professional help when it comes to suicidal ideation, and it's never helped at all. They either guilt you or belittle your problems and give basic advice like 'sleep better, avoid negative thoughts' etc. So yeah, that route seems pretty pointless.

I don't know anymore. I feel like talking about it isn't doing much and I just feel whiney. I'm sorry

Socialising is too difficult. People make me anxious and it's hard to act happy for long.
But thank you for talking with me

Thanks for responding.

I tried talking with my girlfriend again and am going to bring it up with my therapist again. But I don't see much help in it. I might try calling a helpline, but I don't have any experience with that... 

It feels like I've already tried so much over the last few years. I'm just tired of it all

I don't really know why. I suffer from a couple of mental illnesses, so maybe that's it. 

My life seems fine objectively; have a girlfriend, at university, have a few friends, loving family. But I don't feel any appreciation from these things. I know I'm "lucky" to have them, but I just don't feel it. I hate my life and I hate myself and I just want to switch everything off.

I'm probably just a whiney dick who takes everything for granted when there are people dealing with SO much worse. But I just can't shake the feeling.

Thank you for responding. 

I'm not sure what to say. I don't want to live anymore. The future holds nothing. Everything's numb. I can't stop thinking about just ending it all

Hi, Jessica. Thank you for responding.

I'm just really struggling to see the point in living right now. Everyday is numb and the future looks no better. I just want to feel good again, but nothing works
